entries.title: Psalms 17:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 David, in confidence of his integrity, craves defence of God against his enemies. 10 He shews their pride, craft, and eagerness. 13 He prays against them in confidence of his hope.

A.M. 2942. B.C. 1062. (Title.) 86:1; 142:1; *titles Hear. 7:8; 18:20; 43:1; 140:12; 1Jo 3:21 the right. Heb. justice. attend. 5:2; 55:2,3; 61:1; 66:19; 142:6; 2Ch 7:15; Ne 1:6; Da 9:18,19 not out of feigned lips. Heb. without lips of deceit. 18:44; *marg: 145:18; Jer 3:10; Mt 15:8; Joh 1:47

entries.title: Psalms 17:7
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Shew. 31:21; 78:12; Ro 5:20,21; Re 15:3 savest, etc. or, savest them which trust in thee, from thosethat rise up against thy right hand. 5:11,12; 10:12-16; 1Sa 17:45-57; 25:28,29; 2Ki 19:22,34; 2Ch 16:9 by thy. 20:6; 44:3; 60:5; Ex 15:6; Isa 41:10; Ac 2:33

entries.title: Psalms 17:9
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: oppress me. Heb. waste. 1Ch 17:9 deadly enemies. Heb. enemies against the soul. 7:5; 35:4,7,12; 1Sa 24:11

entries.title: Psalms 17:12
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Like, etc. Heb. The likeness of him, (that is, of every oneof them,) is as a lion that desireth to ravin. 7:2; 22:13; 2Ti 4:17; 1Pe 5:8 lurking. Heb. sitting.

entries.title: Psalms 17:13
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Arise. 3:7; 7:6; 44:23,26; 119:126; Isa 51:9 disappoint him. Heb. prevent his face. which is. or, by. 7:11-13 thy. Isa 10:5,15; 13:5; 37:26; Hab 1:12; Ac 4:28

entries.title: Psalms 17:14
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: which are. or, by. men of. Lu 16:8; Joh 8:23; 15:19; 17:14; 1Jo 4:4,5 portion. 49:17-19; 73:12; Lu 12:19-21; 16:25; Jas 5:5 belly. Job 12:6,9; 21:7-15; 22:18 hid. Pr 2:4; Mt 13:44 they are full, etc. or, their children are full. leave. 39:6; Job 21:21; 27:14-17; Lu 16:27,28
